# Cored Hole Depth

Depth of holes formed by core pins compared with their diameter.

<figure markdown="span">
![Cored Hole Depth: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-hole-depth-ratio-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Cored Hole Depth: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-hole-depth-ratio-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Depth of a cored hole against its diameter; through holes may go twice as deep.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 2.0× hole diameter | 3.0× hole diameter | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Deep Cored Hole (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, deeper than the recommended `{target}` its diameter for a `{hole_kind}` hole. Its long core pin can bend under injection pressure and is hard to cool. Make the hole shallower or wider, or core it from both sides.
!!! failure "Error"

    Cored Hole Too Deep (`{measured}` its diameter): `{feature}` is `{size}`, past `{limit}` its diameter for a `{hole_kind}` hole. The slender core pin will deflect, leaving the hole off axis with an uneven wall, and may break. Core it from both sides, make it a through hole, or drill it after moulding.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{hole_kind}` | "blind" or "through" |
